_about: Machine-readable presets for spec-check.mjs and review-frames.mjs. Every number is sourced in platform-specs.md (research dated 2026-09-30). OFF = official platform page, 3P = reputable third party, DERIVED = computed from sourced numbers. Re-verify every 6 months: platforms change these silently.

default.lufsNote: -14 LUFS ±1 (DERIVED: YouTube -14 is 3P-measured; Spotify -14/-1 dBTP OFF analog). Speech-only pieces may sit at -16.

reels.source: Instagram Graph API media reference (OFF): 23-60 fps, 3 s-15 min, 300 MB, moov first; Help Center: >3 min not recommended to new audiences (OFF). Help Center says min 30 fps (conflict), so export 30.

feed45.source: Instagram organic 1080 wide, 1.91:1 to 4:5 (OFF); videos under 15 min post as Reels since 2022 (3P TechCrunch), so Reels API limits apply.

tiktok.source: TikTok Content Posting API media transfer guide (OFF): 23-60 fps, max 10 min, 4 GB, H.264 recommended.

shorts.source: YouTube Help 15424877 (OFF): up to 3 min, square or vertical. Encoding per YouTube 1722171 (OFF).

youtube.source: YouTube 1722171 / 6375112 / 71673 (OFF): H.264 High, 4:2:0, BT.709, faststart, 15 min unless verified.

linkedin.source: LinkedIn Help a1311816 (OFF): 3 s-15 min desktop (10 min mobile), 10-60 fps, 75 KB-5 GB, MOV/QuickTime/AVI no longer supported.

x.source: X Help x-videos (OFF, organic non-Premium): 140 s, 512 MB, max 1920x1200 or 1200x1900, max 40 fps.

universal.source: DERIVED envelope that uploads cleanly to Reels, TikTok, Shorts, LinkedIn and X: 3-140 s, <=300 MB, MP4, 24-30 fps (X caps organic at 40).
DERIVED strict: max per side across Meta Reels ads (OFF: 14% top / 35% bottom / 6% sides) and 3P TikTok/Shorts right margins. Safe rect x 65-940, y 269-1248.

universal-relaxed.source: DERIVED warn tier from organic 3P maxima. Safe rect x 60-940, y 220-1436. Use for organic posts when the strict zone is too tight; captions/CTA still belong in the strict zone.

reels-ads.source: Meta Reels ads guide (OFF): 14% top, 35% bottom, 6% sides.

tiktok.source: 3P (cadenus). TikTok OFF publishes templates only; the zone shrinks as the caption grows.

shorts.source: 3P (postplanify, hopperhq). Google OFF publishes PNG templates only. Shorts ads may compress to 1:1 (y 420-1500).

cover-crops.source: DERIVED: the centre 1080x1080 survives the 3:4 grid, 4:5 and the 1:1 crops. Cover text lives here.

becoming.source: Becoming Project playbook via becoming-video skill (CONFIRMED, Bianno's brand): captions/text inside x 80-940, y 250-1500. Matches IG organic bottom (420); TikTok's 3P bottom is 484, so keep CTAs above y 1436 if cross-posting.

cover-3x4.source: Becoming Project CLAUDE.md (CONFIRMED): reel-cover key text inside the centre 1080x1440 (Instagram's 3:4 profile-grid crop).
